text:
Om Shri Gangai Nathay Namah
Look, regarding the purpose for which you all have come here, I would like to give a brief philosophical explanation. Our country is a spiritually oriented nation, where everyone worships their chosen deity in their own way. However, often we simply assume that our prayers have worked, even though we do not receive any direct response or experience. Hindu Dharma is not limited to rituals alone. This is Kaliyuga — an age of darkness. Just as people take light from the moon and stars during the night, but when the sun rises, the moon and stars still exist yet lose their importance. So today their influence is prominent — the star associated with Christianity and the moon associated with Islam. However, these are prophet-based religions, where knowledge is mainly based on what the prophets have taught. In our tradition, divine incarnations took place, such as Bhagwan Ram and Bhagwan Krishna. This is the land of Bhagwan Krishna’s divine actions, and that is why I am receiving a strong response here. This is my third visit among you.
So this is one way of practicing yoga, but what is being sold today in the name of yoga is not limited to here; it is being sold all over the world. It is only physical exercise, just body movement and fitness. Even physiotherapy doctors can help the body better than this. All this jumping and movement happening in the name of yoga is not the true meaning of yoga. The original purpose of our Yoga philosophy is moksha — liberation. Yoga means plus, the union of the soul and the Supreme Consciousness. But today, no one talks about this anymore. Hardly anyone speaks about liberation.
And among all the gurus who exist, whose name should I take? They themselves have no guru; they are self-proclaimed gurus.Without a guru, this knowledge cannot be attained, understood it or not. I am a householder person just like all of you, but I had to make a guru (Mahayogi Baba Shri GangaiNath Ji Maharaj, Brahmleen). Circumstances compelled me.
Let me tell you about the beginning. Earlier, when I was in service, I worked in the Railways as a Head Clerk.I took premature retirement seven years before my scheduled retirement. Earlier it was a railway job; now it is the service of my guru (Mahayogi Baba Shri GangaiNath Ji Maharaj, Brahmleen). In that job, retirement was possible, but in this one there will be no retirement. One has to work for it throughout life, understood it or not.”
Due to circumstances, a fear of death began to arise within me—what is called a phobia, an unexplained fear. I had a friend who also worked in the railways. He said to me, “You are going through a Markesh phase.” I did not know what Markesh meant. When he explained its meaning, I said, “This will come to everyone.” He replied, “There are ways to overcome it in our spiritual tradition.” I asked, “What?” He said, “Chant the Mahamrityunjaya mantra.” I found it too ritualistic and refused and said, “I will not do this, Dubey ji—let the Markesh come.” Then he said, “You can chant the Gayatri mantra instead.” I agreed to chant Gaytri Mantra. This was in 1968, during the winter Navratri. I began disciplined chanting—morning and evening—keeping a fixed count He also instructed me to offer oblations with “swaha.” I used three to four kilos of ghee for this. He warned that if I did not offer the oblations, the practice could become intense. And it was true— without them, the cycle of 125,000 chants could not be completed.
Today, I need not rise—the 125,000 chants are complete. Yet my eyes opened as always; I would rise daily and bathe in cold water, even in winter. But then meditation happened on its own; I did not even know what meditation was. In the cold, wrapped in a quilt, I remained lying there. I was living in a railway quarter during my service— it was in those days that this realization came.” “Then I saw—this body had transformed into a divine form, as if it had turned into a soft, milky light.” Earlier, before joining the railways, I had done a course as a Probationer Male Nurse in Bikaner. We were taken to post-mortems and shown the organs, so I knew what the liver was, its color, what the heart was, and what the lungs were. Then I saw—no organ was visible at all. I was amazed—where had they gone? As I focused on that light, I heard a humming, like a bee, within the abdomen. When I concentrated on it, the Gayatri Mantra was being chanted from the navel. We see with the eyes outwardly, yet this was visible within.
I had chanted the Gayatri Mantra from the throat, but this was being chanted from the navel. The Gayatri Mantra flowed endlessly—like a moving cycle chain with no end. I remained absorbed in this inner experience for a long time. Suddenly, the sound of running water brought me back. When I opened my eyes, the experience was gone. After that, I closed my eyes and tried again, but nothing appeared.
When word spread about what had happened to me, many people from the Pushkarna community came and asked, “How did this happen?” I replied simply, “It happened like this.” They said, “Use this as a tantric practice. People will give you a lot of money. It will benefit all of us.” At first, I did not understand why people would give money. Then a few groups came—four or five batches—and changes began within me; inner experiences started arising. So I said, “Pandit ji, this is not in my control. I cannot do this. Why should I give gold and take iron in return?” They tried their best to convince me, but when I did not agree, they finally said, “He is a Jat; he will not understand,” and left. But when God takes care of something, everything is taken care of. Then I realized it was the power of the Gayatri Mantra. As Lord Krishna says in the Gita, “Among meters, I am the Gayatri.” Its realization happened—this is the attainment of the formless, the Absolute.
In our country, there are two paths of worship: one is formless (Nirguna) and the other is with form (Saguna).Those who follow the path of form (Saguna) go to Krishna temples, receive Tulsi charanamrit, and live a pure, sattvic life. Those who follow the formless (Nirguna) path chant the Divine Name. Both paths lead to liberation. But for liberation, one has to ascend—to reach the highest center of consciousness, the Sahasrara, understood it or not. Maharshi Aurobindo explained this beautifully. He said that if both realizations—form (Saguna) and formless (Nirguna)—happen in one person, then the force for which one usually has to ascend will instead descend into the physical body. He called this terrestrial immortality. This transformation happened in me in a very simple and innocent way. I never intended for it to happen—it came on its own.
So I realized the power of these mantras. Around that time, I read Swami Vivekananda, who said that one cannot walk the spiritual path without a Guru. So I accepted Nath Ji ( Mahayogi Baba Shri Gangai Nath Ji Maharaj, Brahmleen)  as my Guru. Earlier, I used to think that whatever we offered was what sustained him—that he had nothing of his own. But when he left his body, he placed this burden, this responsibility upon me, and said, ‘Now the work ahead is yours.’ That is why I carry his picture on my head—with reverence and as a reminder of that responsibility.”
In our country, there is a principle of realizing the Supreme (Parabrahman) through the Divine Word (Shabda Brahman). All theistic religions accept that creation arose from the Word—Christianity, Islam, all of them. “But the path of merging back into the Divine Word is a sacred wisdom held and preserved in this land and this Dharma, understood it or not.
In this way, I attained the realization of Krishna. After that, I set out to share it with others. I will give you a mantra—chant it, and transformation will occur, understood it or not. Sri Aurobindo said that two mantras will uplift this nation. The first appeared in 1906—Vande Mataram. Even today, in our country, people are not allowed to say it freely. The second, he said, is the Sanjeevani Mantra—a most secret and mystical mantra, not yet revealed.
You know from the Treta Yuga that when Lakshman became unconscious, Hanuman brought the Sanjeevani herb and gave it to him, and he regained consciousness—if he had died, he would not have come back to life. So, what I am giving you is the mantra of Radha and Krishna—this is a Sanjeevani Mantra. Begin chanting it from now, you will not die from that illness which doctors have declared incurable. Since 1990, I have been giving this challenge in this country—whether it is AIDS, Hepatitis B, blood cancer, or any illness. Science is struggling for answers—there is no doubt about it. In our country and even more so in America, it is facing great difficulty.
This is how both realizations—of the formless Absolute (Nirguna, Nirakara) and the manifested Divine (Saguna, Sakara)—awakened within me, and it happened in an innocent, effortless way.  Because of this—people started experiencing yoga simply through my photograph. This did not happen with the images of Ram or Krishna, because their expressions reflected one aspect (sagun sakar), whereas in me both aspects became consciously active. That is why people began to experience yoga through my image. Today, thousands of women in America are practicing yoga and meditation. Through my image, the process of yoga begins—Kundalini awakens, Khechari Mudra arises naturally, and all ailments are cured. What troubles many is that these transformations are happening through my photograph.
While my programs were going on in Jaipur, officials from NACO (National AIDS Council) intervened and imposed a ban, saying that I was misleading people. An FIR was also filed against me at Naya Shahar police station in Bikaner. I presented the entire matter clearly. There was an SHO there, Joshi Ji, and I told him, “You may charge me.” Later, he himself became my initiate. In fact, after the FIR, he came to receive initiation. He said, “I understand what you are doing. I have the authority to keep the inquiry for up to 90 days.” Yet, within 80 days, the decision came in my favor. The doctor was instructed to carry out all this. They asked if there had been any conflict, and I said yes—there had been a disagreement with Digambar Singh Ji, the Family Welfare Minister of Rajasthan at that time. That doctor has now retired and stays away. Perhaps he fears a defamation case. It makes no difference to me. This is my mission, not my profession. If it were a profession, I too would have filed a defamation case. Whether people praise me or criticize me does not affect me. My work is simply to do good and let it go—this is the command of my Guru.
If you chant the Divine Name in this way (round the clock), your Kundalini will awaken. It then takes your body, breath, mind, and intellect under its control, and all yogic movements begin to unfold on their own. Yogic movements will arise in the specific part of the body that is not functioning properly, it will stimulate and tone only that particular part, and it will continue there until that body part is fully restored and functioning properly. In this way all physical ailments will be cured—such as arthritis, asthma, and diabetes all will be cured.
In this way all physical ailments will be cured—such as arthritis, asthma, and diabetes all will be cured. Serious illnesses like AIDS and cancer can be life-threatening, while arthritis does not usually take life but can severely affect the body—causing swelling, stiffness, and making the hands and legs feel almost locked. There are countless cases that have been cured. Thyroid is a relatively minor condition, but it has two types—hypothyroidism and hyperthyroidism. In one, a person becomes unnecessarily overweight, while in the other, a person becomes very thin. Both conditions are being cured. Doctors often say that medicines must be taken for life, with doses adjusted from time to time and regular visits required. Here, however, they are being cured within just a few days. All diseases, including hypertension and hypotension, are being cured.
In this way, when you chant the divine name, the Kundalini will initiate the yogic process—right now, in this very moment. Once I leave, this will not happen in the same way. Many gurus say that if you follow their instructions for twenty years, your Kundalini will awaken. But I ask, will both the guru and the disciple even be in this world after twenty years? This is a functional yoga. I will guide you into meditation now, and after initiation, by giving the mantra, the yogic process will unfold—understood it or not. Therefore, physical ailments and mental disturbances come to an end.
Mental tension lies behind 80% of illnesses. Doctors may give sedatives that calm the mind for a few hours, but when their effect fades, the same tension returns—and the illness remains. We too bring about an intoxication, but not of a material kind. It is the intoxication of the Divine Name—of spirit, not matter. The saints call this Naam Khumari—the intoxication of the Name. Guru Nanak Dev Ji said: ‘The intoxication of bhang and dhatura lasts only till dawn, O Nanak; but the bliss of the Divine Name endures day and night. Kabir Das Ji expresses the same truth: ‘The intoxication of the Divine Name never fades, O brother. All other intoxications come and go, but the intoxication of the Name only grows stronger with each passing day.” Thus, when the intoxication of the Divine Name awakens, there is no need for any other intoxication.
So many people say, ‘Don’t drink alcohol—it’s like a venomous snake. Don’t take opium or heroin—don’t consume such things.’ But does anyone listen? It goes in one ear and out the other. I say—don’t try to give it up. I’ve been giving this challenge since 1990—don’t give it up. Even increase it—drink one and a half bottles instead of one—go ahead and try. You won’t be able to drink if you keep chanting the Divine Name. If you do not chant the Divine Name, the addiction will not leave you. The intoxication of the Divine Name must arise. In this way, all addictions fall away. Mental suffering ends, and physical ailments also come to an end.
A very unusual kind of evolution has appeared on the surface—and people are deeply disturbed, especially those in science. I have submitted at least five hundred reports from Ranbaxy Labs of people cured of AIDS to the Government of India. My disciples wrote to A. P. J. Abdul Kalam (then President of India) and handed the letter over to him. He passed them on to Atal Ji (then Prime Minister of India) and Sushma Swaraj (then Health and Family Welfare Minister of India), but no attention was given. Why would Sonia Gandhi pay attention now? What connection does she have with Hinduism? A transformation is coming that has never happened before. People say, ‘This has never occurred earlier.’ Our philosophy speaks of evolution. Maharshi Aurobindo said, ‘Man is a transitional being; he is not final, but he will be.’ What he spoke of—I am bringing into living form, whether you understand it or not
The Rig Veda says that the human body is composed of seven elements: matter (anna), life (prana), mind (mana), knowledge (vijnana), and sat, chit, and ananda. The four sheaths (koshas)—annamaya, pranamaya, manomaya, and vijnanamaya—have been explored and activated by science, especially in the West. Today, America stands as the leading force in this field. That is why I went there, and I will go again in June. I have shared this material with six universities in America—the same that I had given to the Prime Minister here. I told them that until the three higher sheaths (koshas)—sachchidananda (Sat-Chit-Ananda) satmaya, chitmaya, and anandama—are awakened, the problems of the world will not come to an end. In our tradition, the sage Yajnavalkya attained the Anandamaya Kosha—the state of bliss—but beyond that, into chit and sat, people have not yet reached.
When you meditate in this way, your Kundalini awakens and begins the yogic process within you. In our yogic system, there are five types of vayus (vital energies): prana, apana, samana, udana, and vyana. Prana vayu is connected with the breath, as practiced in pranayama. Apana vayu operates below the navel and helps eliminate waste from the body. The same divine power you worship as Sita, Radha, Parvati, Amba, or Durga is what yogis call Kundalini. It resides at the base of the spine, in the region known as the sacrum, where it lies dormant—coiled three and a half times, with its tail held in its mouth. When it awakens, it rises upward, becoming straight, because its source—the master—resides in the Sahasrara, the crown center.
Now, as the Kundalini rises to unite with her master, how does it ascend? It needs a push—a thrust—like a rocket lifting off, just as India has sent one to the moon. In this way, the yogic process begins. The locks (bandhas) are applied—three in total. First, at the Muladhara, a lock forms so that apana vayu no longer moves downward; since its nature is to move, it begins to rise upward. As soon as the Kundalini rises above the navel, the second lock is applied—this is called Uddiyana Bandha; regardless of one’s body type, the navel draws inward toward the spine. As it continues to rise and passes the throat region, the third lock is applied—this is called Jalandhara Bandha. Beyond the neck, movement in the spine is not possible, and pranayama then begins to occur automatically. When complete kumbhaka (breath retention) is attained and the Kundalini rises beyond the Ajna chakra, meditation deepens into a state of samadhi.
I told them in the West clearly—until the higher three sheaths (Satmaya Kosha, Chitmaya Kosha, and Anandamaya Kosha) are awakened, your science cannot accomplish it.” Matter alone can do nothing; you must add spirit to it. “When I initiated them into yoga, thousands of men and women began to experience spontaneous yogic movements, even through my photograph. I have visited America twice. Now they in the West are perplexed, wondering what the explanation is—how such effects can occur even through a photograph. Thousands of women, thanks to the internet, download my photograph from my website (https://t.co/lTDK7YpLU3) and meditate on it. One woman told her husband, ‘Sit in the other room and call me at this exact minute and second while I meditate.’ Her husband was 2–3 seconds late, yet her eyes opened on their own—exactly at the 15-minute mark. She said, ‘This man is sitting in India, yet he is producing results all over the planet.
And if all this becomes known to the world, then where will AIDS and cancer remain? That is why the wealthy are more disturbed. No one truly seeks to eliminate AIDS—no one. Even our own government does not move to end it. Dr. Manmohan Singh formed a council of cabinet ministers and warned that if AIDS is not contained, development itself will collapse. They speak of control, of prevention—but not of complete eradication. Crores are being spent in the name of awareness. Countless organizations and NGOs have emerged.
There is even a law that anyone making such claims can be punished with one year of imprisonment. A case was filed against me under the Magic Act of 1954. They said, ‘You give mantra initiation—you perform magic.’ I said, ‘Yes, I certainly do magic—but there are two kinds: black and white. Look into your own dictionary. What I am doing—does it bring harm, or does it bring peace, relief, and diseases like AIDS cured, then what kind of magic is this?’ An FIR has been filed—it is still lying there. It does not matter to me. I have no desire to file a defamation suit.
I told Dr. Manmohan Singh Ji, ‘Your Ambumani Ramadoss, then the Health and Family Welfare Minister, has issued notice to Swami Ramdev—why don’t you issue one to me? Is there not even space for one person like me in Tihar Jail?’ But they know that if they act against me, it will only increase my publicity. ‘He is an 82-year-old man,’ they think, ‘he will live a year or two and then die.’ So I tell them, ‘Death is certain—whoever is born must die. But this phenomenon of yoga manifesting through my photograph —myphotograph will never die. As long as the world exists, it will remain. It is inert matter, is it not?’ They themselves say that such results are coming to the living from something non-living. That is why they are indeed disturbed. But ultimately, my purpose is to make this dharma a universal dharma. I have nothing to do with disease or suffering. I speak of self-realization. I will introduce you to your own true self—who you really are, whether you understand it now or not.’”
Swami Vivekananda propagated the message there in a remarkable way, and after Yogānanda Ji and Vivekananda Ji, hardly anyone went there in that spirit. Since then, there has been opposition toward Hindus, and even today many people hold negative views about them. But now, there are at least five million Patels from Gujarat living there. They have built strong organizations, and every Sunday they gather for prayer. I also visited there and stayed in New York at the home of Kanu Bhai Patel from Ahmedabad. Whenever they called—even twenty times a day—they would greet with ‘Jai Shri Krishna.’ I said, ‘your community has done something remarkable—you have made “Jai Shri Krishna” echo across America. His son once performed in a play in Florida. I asked him, ‘What role did you play?’ He said, ‘I played Abhimanyu.’ Imagine—portraying such a role in a land where there is opposition to Hindus, especially from certain Christian groups.
A girl named Elizabeth Harper once came to me from London to receive initiation. Her mother was with her. She said, ‘Guru Ji, when this girl was about ten or eleven years old, she used to say that in her previous birth she had been a pilot.’ Her father even took her into an airplane, and this eleven-year-old girl landed the plane. Later, the girl moved to America and married Dennis Kucinich, who had run in the presidential elections, though he later withdrew—he is a simple man. When I later visited America, she met me again. I asked, ‘Elizabeth, can you speak about it now?’ She replied, ‘Guru Ji, the Christians will trouble me.’ She added, ‘My mother knows it, and I also know that I landed the plane. At the time of initiation, I said to her mother, ‘This is a great injustice.’ She asked, ‘Why?’ I said, ‘Your Bible says that graves will open, the dead will rise, and judgment will take place. Then why did she come before that? Where is her judgment? I said, ‘Our dharma is complete; Christianity is still incomplete—we will bring it to completion. Mother became inwardly displeased. She knew that, until recently, we had lived under British rule, like slaves. But the girl was not concerned with that—she was writing a thesis on why there is no peace. Today, she is Dennis Kucinich’s wife. He may have held a cabinet-level position—I’m not sure what role he was given; I haven’t followed the news.
In this way, a development is taking place—a human evolution is unfolding, whether you understand it or not. Dharana, Dhyana, and Samadhi are the subtle limbs of Yoga. Samadhi can occur only when Dharana becomes firm. Along with the chanting of mantra that I will give now, you will close your eyes, focus here (the Ajna Chakra), and meditate. Movement will arise, and you will begin to believe—what never happened before, why is it happening now? I accept people of all communities. In Mumbai, there are hundreds of Muslim women and men who are my disciples and they have been cured from AIDS and even completed the Hajj. This is a transformation happening within the human being—a change within the human body itself, whether you understand it or not
All theistic religions have foretold the creation of a new world.’ This new world will not descend from above—it will emerge from within, from among you. What will this new world be like? It is described as the creation of a spiritual world. And what will people be like in that spiritual world? It is said there will be a divine transformation of human beings.
So, I have set out for this transformation—and it is happening across all communities, whether you understand it or not. A very unique and profound change is unfolding.”
Now, one of the greatest phenomena is that Khechari Mudra begins to occur spontaneously. Our Guru, Gorakhnath Ji, said:
‘In the celestial realm there is an inverted well filled with nectar.
The true disciple drinks from it again and again, while the one without a Guru remains thirsty.’
Lakhs of my disciples are experiencing Khechari Mudra. When I first came to Gujarat, people were astonished by it. But now people say, ‘It is happening on its own.

"Qatar's Sheikh Mohammed visits Washington after Tehran visit last week
Rubio says diplomatic breakthrough is not imminent and rejects Iran's truce terms as unrealistic
Iran plan pushes nuclear talks back to later stage.

 US President Donald Trump said on Monday he plans to hold off on new military strikes against Iran for the time being after appeals from ​countries in the region, including from Qatar's prime minister in White House talks.

"The United States of America is fully locked and loaded with the best equipment ever made, and we don't think there's going to be any reason to use it," Trump told reporters.
He said he was acting "at the behest of countries that are their neighbors" and specifically cited Qatar, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain, Kuwait and others that prefer the US not launch new ​attacks.

DIPLOMATIC MOVES
Al-Thani, who is both prime minister and foreign minister ​of Qatar, met Trump after visiting Tehran last week.
The prime minister called his talks with both Trump and Vice President JD Vance positive.
"Grateful for the positive discussions on reaching a deal and bringing peace to the region," he said on X.
Iranian security council chief Mohsen Rezaei said on X the US should "stop manufacturing fake news about imaginary talks" and that it was "time to surrender to the seven conditions Iran has repeatedly set out."

Iran's proposal to end the war involves ​an end to the US blockade of its ports, the lifting of some sanctions and a halt to bombing in return for Tehran stopping its own blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, with talks ​on its nuclear programme and other sanctions to follow.

The US has repeatedly rejected that plan, with Secretary of State Marco Rubio describing Tehran's conditions on Sunday as "outrageous and ridiculous and really not realistic."

Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil ‌Baghaei defended the ⁠plan on Monday as the most reasonable offer on the table.

Senior US Republicans including Vice President JD Vance have blamed their party's losses in last week's elections on the Iran war. Despite the growing domestic political pressure to end the conflict, Rubio said he did not believe a diplomatic breakthrough was imminent.
A senior United Arab Emirates official, Anwar Gargash, echoed that view on Monday, saying a comprehensive political settlement between the US and Iran appeared difficult.

Vance, who led the negotiations for ​a short-lived truce in June, will also meet ​Al-Thani, whose country has been a prime mediator ⁠since early in the war, conveying messages between the sides and proposing ways to bridge their differences.

Anxiety over the war has pervaded the region for months, and Turkish President Tayyip Erdogan said on Monday he had told Trump that Ankara did not want to see a new escalation.
"We emphasise at every ​opportunity that it is possible to resolve these issues through dialogue and diplomacy. Unfortunately, we see a negative shift once again. We are doing our ​utmost to prevent this," Erdogan ⁠told reporters.

MILITARY ACTION
Sunday night's strikes on Qeshm island did not impact vital infrastructure or services, a provincial official told Iran's semi-official Fars news agency on Monday. The US has not commented on the Iranian media reports.
A senior Iranian source told Reuters that US strikes were targeting Iranian radar systems serving both air defence and ship navigation, as well as bases for missile launchers and mine-laying systems.

Attacks on tankers in the Gulf and Strait ⁠of Hormuz ​ramped up sharply in October and have continued at the highest rate since the start of the war, figures from international ​maritime agencies showed last week.
Iran, which typically does not acknowledge striking vessels that report being hit by projectiles, said on Sunday a tanker had hit a mine east of the Strait of Hormuz.
A state television reporter said on Monday that 11 tankers ​had been "disabled" over the past 10 days."

🇮🇷|Rezaei Used the Word "Surrender." Not "negotiate." Not "comply." Surrender. Read the Change in the Vocabulary.

Mohsen Rezaei, Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council, posted on X early Tuesday, 10 November 2026: "The time has come to surrender to Iran's seven conditions. The war against Iran has inflicted severe damage upon the U.S. administration, yet Washington continues to flail about like a desperate gambler. Stop fabricating fake news regarding illusory negotiations, and cease denying the new order in West Asia."

Three new elements. None of them appeared in his previous statements.

The Word Itself

The seven conditions were published by the Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces and Commander of the Khatm al-Anbiya Central Headquarters. They were described as conditions to be implemented. Al-Mayadeen reported the position that no diplomacy advances until all seven are implemented fully and simultaneously. Esmail Baghaei compressed the timeline from seven days to two.

The vocabulary in all of those statements was conditional. Conditions to be met. A window to be used. A timeline to be observed.

Rezaei's word is surrender. That is the language of a victor addressing a defeated party, not a negotiator addressing a counterparty. The Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council has moved the frame from "meet these terms" to "accept defeat."

That shift is the news.

The Accusation of Fabricated Negotiations

"Stop fabricating fake news regarding illusory negotiations."

Read that against the record of the past week. The Western press reported that a senior Iranian official was physically in Doha for talks. The Iranian government plane that landed in Doha was corrected by Tasnim: it was carrying the Minister of Communications and his delegation to the World Telecommunication Development Conference. A security official denied reports of an upcoming Doha meeting between Rezaei and the US Vice President.

The sequence was: a report appears, the report implies progress, Iran denies the report, and the denial receives a fraction of the coverage the original report received. The net effect is an impression in Western capitals that talks are advancing and Iran is softening.

Rezaei is naming that mechanism. He is not accusing the press of error. He is accusing Washington of manufacturing the appearance of negotiation to cover the absence of one.

That is a precise charge and it has a documented basis. There is no US ambassador in Tehran. The letter from JD Vance was read and left unanswered. The Doha channel runs through Qatari mediators whose capital hosts Al Udeid. And the security council secretary is saying the reports of progress are being generated on the American side.

"Desperate Gambler" Is the Diagnosis

The metaphor is not decorative. A gambler who has lost keeps playing because stopping means accepting the loss. He raises the stake to recover the stake.

The American ledger: $47 billion spent. 56 MQ-9 Reapers downed. Six MQM-170s captured intact. 274 US military facilities damaged across seven countries. Two aircraft squawking 7700 in one window. The southern route of the strait dark after the strike on Didamar Island's radar and communications. Task Force Iron Gate  twenty personnel in Tampa attempting to close a land bridge after the sea route failed.

And the domestic ledger: Vance conceded the war lost the election. Trump Jr. endorsed the concession. Rubio reportedly preparing to resign. Hegseth under prediction of dismissal. Cooper mocked as a podcast host by an IRGC spokesman and the Foreign Ministry.

A gambler in that position does not leave the table. He doubles down, and he tells the room the cards are turning. That is what "fabricating fake news regarding illusory negotiations" describes  the reassurance offered to the room while the chips are gone.

"The New Order in West Asia" Has a Membership List

"Cease denying the new order in West Asia."

That phrase would be empty without a filing behind it. The filing exists and it is dated.

The CIS+1 framework was welcomed by CIS member states after President Masoud Pezeshkian proposed it. Russia backed it. Turkmenistan, a state with UN-recognised permanent neutrality adopted by General Assembly resolution on 12 December 1995, proposed it. Pezeshkian was the first Iranian president invited to a CIS Council of Heads of State meeting, on 9 October 2024.

The Beijing architecture: Ali Bagheri Kani endorsed a Chinese-led regional security framework alongside Wang Yi regional arrangements without the United States and without the entity. The Sultan of Oman was in Beijing the same day. The Chinese Special Envoy was booked for Tehran, Muscat and Riyadh.

The Hormuz Mechanism: condition six of the seven. The replacement of the American security umbrella at sea.

Twelve foreign ministers called in 48 hours — Oman, Egypt, Jordan, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Cyprus, Turkey, Kuwait, the UAE, Tunisia, Iraq, Pakistan. Not one call to Washington.

The gas pipeline from Russia through Iran, discussed after the Kremlin meeting with Vladimir Putin, with Yuri Ushakov and GRU chief Igor Kostyukov in the room.

The INSTC, the Chabahar connection, the Kazakhstan-Turkmenistan-Iran railway at 908 kilometres opened December 2014.

That is a membership list. A "new order" is not a slogan when it has a rail gauge, a gas tariff, a customs committee and a summit photograph.

The Escalation Ladder, Complete

Rezaei's three statements in sequence:

First: the four names — Vance conceded, Rubio leaving, Hegseth predicted to fall, Cooper a podcast host — and the question: to whom in Washington should the message be delivered?

Second: the answer to that question was silence. The address remained empty.

Third: surrender.

The escalation is not rhetorical. The security council secretary asked who could sign. Nobody answered. So he stopped asking and started dictating terms.

That is what the shift from "conditions" to "surrender" means. The window Baghaei compressed from seven days to two has closed on the question of who receives the document. The document is now being read aloud instead of handed over.

The bill.

Rezaei, Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council, on X, 10 November 2026. "Surrender." "Desperate gambler." "Fabricated fake news regarding illusory negotiations." "The new order in West Asia."

The corrected Doha manifest: the Communications Minister at the WTDC, not a negotiating team. The denied meeting between Rezaei and the US Vice President. The Vance letter read and unanswered. No ambassador in Tehran.

$47 billion. 56 Reapers. Six MQM-170s captured. 274 facilities. Two aircraft squawking 7700. Didamar's radar dark. Twenty personnel in Tampa.

CIS+1 welcomed. Beijing architecture endorsed. Hormuz Mechanism drafted. Twelve calls, none to Washington. The gas pipeline discussed with the GRU chief in the room. The INSTC running.

The word is surrender. The address is empty. The new order has a membership list. The bill is being presented, not negotiated.

@justadedayo you asked a question.

As a prospective Governor of Ogun State, my vision is to build a state where every citizen has opportunities to succeed, where young people are empowered, and where leadership is measured by results rather than promises.

What do I have to offer the youths of Ogun State?

I believe our youths deserve more than political promises. They deserve employment opportunities, skills acquisition programmes, entrepreneurship support, access to affordable education, technology training and an enabling environment to turn their talents into productive ventures. My vision is to make young people active participants in governance and economic development.

What do I have to offer Ogun State in general?

I envision a state with quality healthcare, functional public schools, modern markets, good roads, reliable electricity, improved security, agricultural development, industrial growth and transparent management of public resources. Every local government and community deserves inclusive development. No part of Ogun State should be left behind.

What do I have to offer final-year students of Obafemi Awolowo University?

To every final-year student preparing to graduate, I understand that obtaining a degree should be the beginning of opportunities, not the beginning of frustration. My vision includes stronger university-industry partnerships, graduate employment programmes, entrepreneurship funding opportunities, internship placements, career development and practical skills training to help graduates transition confidently into the workforce.

My commitment is to leadership that listens, serves and delivers; leadership that creates opportunities rather than excuses, and development that reaches the ordinary people.

Ogun State deserves a future where the youths have opportunities, families have hope, businesses can grow and every citizen can live with dignity.

That is the kind of governance I believe in: PEOPLE FIRST, DEVELOPMENT ALWAYS"

text:
Men will build an incredible life yet STILL feel like they're not enough to be loved

It's been 1 month since I've seen her.

The last time we were together, on a sunny autumn day, we took some mushies. What followed was one of the most horrifying, but revealing experiences I've EVER had as a man. 100+ psychedelic experiences under my belt and somehow THIS was the one that shattered me like a china doll. The ironic thing is, it happened in the presence of the woman who gave me the purest expression of love I've ever received.

Let me rewind a bit.

I was in Tahoe for a friend's wedding. Had decided last minute to arrive a week early, stay w my other buddy at his new lake house, help him build a sauna, boat, wakesurf, etc. No particular reason for changing my plans; just intuitively felt right. I smile writing this. now it all makes sense.

The first day out on the boat, I met her completely by chance. A friend of a friend - she had a broken foot & was hobbling around on this hilarious little walking device iWalk 3000 or something like that hahah. Despite being physically crippled, she was juicing her lemons into lemonade in a way I have never seen anyone do; it was admirable to watch her worship life despite the adversity. The honest truth is that it didn't feel super easy right away, the connection, but something about her energy & beauty pushed me to indulge. We ended up spending that night together, talking about everything and nothing. The next morning I moved into her family's ski cabin down the road, where she was living by herself for the fall season.

Too soon? yeah yeah, I hear you. But my intuition had already brought me here, and I felt it continuing to speak. Recently -- whether it be business partners, income, freedom, love that ends up shattering my expectations -- I've become pretty great at allowing the inexplicable life forces to guide me towards what I need to be experiencing. It felt so obviously RIGHT that questioning it became the irrational thing to do.

The next two weeks were unlike anything I'd experienced with a woman before. We lived a blissfully simple life. Homemade pasta, baking sourdough, music in the kitchen as I danced around and she smiled ear to ear, bobbing her head and swaying her hips on that little walking device. We'd work for hours - her on her studies, me on my biz - at night cuddling up in the conversation pit next to the fire & talk about everything under the sun.

By all markers, she was incredible. I kept saying - "wow, you are a proper WOMAN." She liked that, blushing every time. A former pro ballerina, studying to become a doctor, wildly intelligent, conscious, giggly, funny, disciplined, creative, & deeply feminine.

Recently, I wrote on X the story of when I was inspired to take her shopping one afternoon. I bought her what felt like the entire store. She hadn't asked for anything. The thing about her is she NEVER asks for ANYTHING. Which ironically, embeds this visceral desire to care for her, to expand her world a little, to see her light up. That experience taught me what it meant for a man to truly provide. Lesson after lesson.

The most interesting part of all of this "falling for her" story? I had never even seen this woman WALK properly. Her broken foot meant so much of the physical expression of our relationship was limited. I found myself thinking how much of human to human understanding thrives from simple things we take for granted, like twirling her around in the kitchen, or walking stride by stride. Even still, I felt more attracted to her than women I'd previously pursued with every ounce of physical chemistry we were able to juice out of the connection. I kept imagining what it would be like to see her dance, hike together, run through the trees. If what we were experiencing together was this rich, with such a integral part missing, how elated would the connection be once she healed?

Fast forward to our last day together. I had a flight to catch the following morning. It was a calm autumn day, the lake calm and the sun still warm from the lingering summer. We decided to spend the afternoon on the sand with some mushies. The two of us have had a close relationship with psychedelics throughout our lives, and we'd already been quite vulnerable with each other. My inner child felt particularly free in our sharing of life thus far, so why not give a nod to our onion friend & peel back one more layer?

The trip started & we were in flow. We joked, giggled, cuddled, played in the sand. She shimmied and rolled down toward the water's edge with her broken foot, like a little mermaid trying to move on land. It was hilariously precious. Afternoon sun glistened off the wet sand, reflecting back onto her angelic face. Fuck, she was so beautiful. I remember telling her that and feeling an overwhelming amount of love.

Then she began speaking about me leaving. oh no, I thought, not now. But her tone was calm, hopeful, almost grounded. She told me:

"Baby, when you leave, remember always that you are yours. Not MINE. I love you unconditionally. I SEE you. I want you to follow your heart, to be present, to experience life. Even if that means meeting other women, exploring intimacy with them, whatever feels authentic to you. I don't own you, and you don't own me. If we find a way to continue this, beautiful. If this is all we ever get, these two weeks have been extraordinary, and I'll be eternally grateful. You cannot take away my love for myself, and I will never ask you to sacrifice your freedom to prove that you love me."

I'm paraphrasing slightly, but that was the essence of it. She's quite expressive, a very talented poet, so it wasn't surprise that she was able to take a very challenging topic and attack it with such elegance. We'd had many of conversations along these lines before; they've all felt easy. Must be the ballerina in her, the ultimate presentation of grace.

I lay there staring up at this beautiful mermaid perched on her arms, legs swaying back and forth in the gentle shorebreak, golden afternoon sun illuminating her body. I wanted to say a million things. Tell her how much I loved her, how deeply I SEE her, how grateful I was that she'd entered my life.

But I couldn't speak. My throat CLOSED. I felt like some invisible being was choking me. And then everything went dark.

I started spiraling into what ppl would call a "bad trip." I'd had over 100 psychedelic experiences before this, and NEVER experienced anything like it. Her beautiful face started distorting into something demonic. The warm golden beach reality around me turned cold, frightening, almost hostile.

My mind began a full frontal assault, storming the beaches of Normandy. worse - I was the axis power. I'm not good enough. Nobody actually loves me. My business is a failure. I don't have real friends. I'm not successful. My freedom is over. I don't deserve this woman. I'm not enough for her.

Thoughts that ordinarily would pass through my mind and disappear without judgement suddenly became my entire reality. I couldn't observe them anymore. I WAS them.

I waded out into the shallow lake, trying desperately to find some sense of myself. Blank. Lights on no one home. It felt like the entire foundation of who I believed myself to be had just disappeared.

Eventually I mustered up the courage to return to the beach and sat with her. I tried to explain what was happening, but the words wouldn't come. The entire time she was rubbing my arm, telling me it was ok. I felt ashamed, distant from the man I'd spent years becoming.

And then, in near insanity, I told her I wanted to break up. I was scared that my darkness would eventually hurt her, and I wanted to remove myself before that could happen.

She calmly put her hand on my leg, with the same energy a mother gives to a crying baby, like "there, there, sweet child."

Then she said - "Baby, if that's what you feel you need to do, that's okay. I love you unconditionally. But also... we're not even dating. I don't possess you. You're free to do whatever you want. There's nothing to break up."

Fuck me 😂

Here I was, attempting to BREAK UP with a woman I've known for 2 weeks. A woman who wasn't even asking me for a relationship. She was offering me complete freedom, and somehow my brain had interpreted this as an existential threat. Where the FUCK was this coming from?

We returned to the house, and I asked her to give me some time alone. I got into the shower, sat down, closed my eyes, and started meditating. I needed to understand what had just happened. this wasn't me.

I began moving my awareness through my body's energy centers (I align with the chakra framework in this sense, but if you are religious, this could manifest in many different ways. Everyone has their own unique pathway to enter this space). Root chakra was secure. Sacral felt good. Then I arrived at my solar plexus (the energy center of ur body that controls self worth and expression). Damn, that's where I hit the proverbial oil deposit - dark and gooey, but containing riches once refined.

There was a gutwrenching pain and chest tightness. This overwhelming feeling of contraction, like something deep inside me was refusing to open.

Then I saw it. Somewhere deep in my subconscious, in a dark place that I don't want to see, I have a wound around SELF WORTH in romantic relationships.

Not necessarily a fully blocked solar plexus, not some fundamental inability to love myself. Quite the opposite actually. In most dimensions of my life I have tremendous self-esteem. I love the man I've become. I'm proud of the businesses I've built, the impact I have made, the friendships I've cultivated, the freedom I've created, the way I show up in the world.

But apparently there's a part of me that doesn't fully believe I'm ENOUGH when it comes to receiving deep romantic love. That's fucking crazy.

I realized that somewhere along the way (probably from my upbringing and adolesence), I'd learned to treat a woman's love as something I needed to EARN, secure, protect, and somehow make permanent. Thus the deeper the tendrils expanded, the more terrifying the possibility of losing that love felt.

This is why when this woman looked into my eyes and told me she loved me WITHOUT asking for ownership, exclusivity, promises, or guarantees... I had absolutely no clue how to receive it, even though if you would've asked me about it, I would have said that I felt consciously ready for it.

My conscious mind read her completely. I resonated with the epithets she constantly expressed. Love without grasping. Freedom without abandonment. Devotion without possession. I'd been exploring these concepts for years. I was ready for this. Right? RIGHT?!?!

But I am reminded again - knowing something intellectually & actually EMBODYING it are two very different things.

This is a profound lesson, and what I find remarkable about this experience.

I've spent years working on myself - my masculinity, my confidence, my ability to provide, my emotional depth. I've gotten pro athlete good at GIVING love. At creating beautiful experiences for women, making them feel safe, expanding their lives, allowing them to be vulnerable around me.

But now for the first time I was realizing - had I ever really learned how to RECEIVE that same love without feeling that I needed to somehow deserve it?

There on that beach was a woman essentially telling me, "You are enough right now in this here without doing a single thing to prove it." And some wack wounded part of me responded, "No I'm fucking not." That's a pretty icky thing to discover about yourself.

It also made me realize something about attachment. I don't think a relationship goal should be to make urself immune to whether someone stays or leaves. Of course you care. Ofc losing somebody you love would hurt like a bitch. That vulnerability is part of what makes love viciously real.

But there's an stark difference between WANTING somebody in your life and NEEDING them to remain there in order to feel whole. If her choosing me becomes the sign that I am worthy of love in the first place, then what happens to my self-worth if she stops choosing me? It disappears with her.

And this is all I knew. So I tried to disappear her, to protect myself. The sad thing is, this is no longer loving freely. No - we're majorly off track. I'm now in a state of grasping, controlling, protecting myself, trying to negotiate certainty out of something that by its very nature can never be guaranteed.

The truth is - a LOT of powerful men unknowingly do this. We build our careers, make money, get in shape, develop charisma, accumulate status, become desirable. Yet somewhere deep underneath all of that "achievement" is a little boy who's still terrified that without those things, nobody would actually choose him.

I don't think that's true of every man. But sitting in that shower, I realized some version of it was true of me.

As the warm water trickled down my face, I was in shock. She didn't FIX anything. She didn't descend out of the rescue helicopter, pull me up on a rope, and blast out of there. She didn't convince me I was worthy, or magically heal years of subconscious conditioning. No - she simply showed up as herself, offered me love without trying to possess me, was authentically her, strong. In doing so, an environment was created where something I'd kept buried finally became visible.

Mirror. That's all she is. That's all we are for one another.

The most profound gift another human being can give you isn't making you feel good about yourself. It's helping you see the parts of yourself that you don't even want to know.

I'm not saying that one mushroom trip and a shower meditation healed this wound. Far from it. Identifying something vs actually integrating it into how you live are two very different processes. I have work to do. I'm learning that the most vital life work has little to do with building another business, or becoming more "successful" in worldly terms.

In this moment what my intuition presented to me, what I'm certain will elevate me to the next level of life enjoyment & consciousness: my worth doesn't begin when somebody chooses me, and it doesn't end if they decide to leave.

I can love this woman with my entire being, want to build something beautiful with her, and STILL belong completely to myself.

Maybe this is real intimacy. Not finding somebody who finally "completes" you, but rather finding somebody who makes you feel safe enough to discover where you've been believing you were incomplete all along.

It's been a month since I've seen her, yet I can't stop thinking about those two weeks that ended on the shores of that autumn lake.

The person I've been waiting for all along is me, and he is enough.

MY VISION FOR OGUN STATE: A FUTURE OF OPPORTUNITIES, DEVELOPMENT AND GOOD GOVERNANCE.

@justadedayo you asked a question.

As a prospective Governor of Ogun State, my vision is to build a state where every citizen has opportunities to succeed, where young people are empowered, and where leadership is measured by results rather than promises.

What do I have to offer the youths of Ogun State?

I believe our youths deserve more than political promises. They deserve employment opportunities, skills acquisition programmes, entrepreneurship support, access to affordable education, technology training and an enabling environment to turn their talents into productive ventures. My vision is to make young people active participants in governance and economic development.

What do I have to offer Ogun State in general?

I envision a state with quality healthcare, functional public schools, modern markets, good roads, reliable electricity, improved security, agricultural development, industrial growth and transparent management of public resources. Every local government and community deserves inclusive development. No part of Ogun State should be left behind.

What do I have to offer final-year students of Obafemi Awolowo University?

To every final-year student preparing to graduate, I understand that obtaining a degree should be the beginning of opportunities, not the beginning of frustration. My vision includes stronger university-industry partnerships, graduate employment programmes, entrepreneurship funding opportunities, internship placements, career development and practical skills training to help graduates transition confidently into the workforce.

My commitment is to leadership that listens, serves and delivers; leadership that creates opportunities rather than excuses, and development that reaches the ordinary people.

Ogun State deserves a future where the youths have opportunities, families have hope, businesses can grow and every citizen can live with dignity.

That is the kind of governance I believe in: PEOPLE FIRST, DEVELOPMENT ALWAYS.

—— Dr BÓLÁJÍ MARIÊ ODÙSÍNÀ BMO

text:
For more than 80 years, stories of China and the U.S. fighting side by side during WWII have lain buried in the archives. But today, as China handed over the remains of American airmen who lost their lives flying the perilous Hump Route, a remarkable chapter of that shared history came back to life. I found this interesting item in the archives that illustrates that remarkable period.

Among the lesser-known stories of the Hump Route is one about communication. How could a Yank, parachuting into an unfamiliar land, make himself understood to Chinese villagers who spoke not a word of English?

The answer lay in something surprisingly simple: a piece of cloth.

Known as a “blood chit” 血幅, it bore a message in Chinese 来华助战洋人(美国)，军民一体救护, which meant “this American has come to China to help fight the war. All Chinese soldiers and civilians are asked to offer him protection and assistance.” 

Those chits were usually sewn inside the flight jackets of Hump crews, who would show them to local Chinese when those pilots were forced to parachute into remote areas of China. The message on the chit directed Chinese to take downed fliers to the nearest U.S. Army base.

For pilots stranded in unfamiliar mountains, unable to speak the language, a few Chinese characters could speak louder than a thousand English words.

Apparently, God understood something that certain religious enthusiasts still struggle to comprehend: being spiritual does not eliminate the ordinary responsibilities associated with possessing a physical body. Soldiers had to eat, drink, sleep, and attend to bodily functions. Those necessities were not themselves proof of rebellion. But the LORD required them to be handled according to His instructions rather than leaving waste scattered throughout the place where the nation lived and moved.

The command demonstrates that holiness and ordinary cleanliness were related within the camp without becoming identical concepts. Human waste could create offensive and unhealthy conditions if handled carelessly, and the prescribed arrangement required removal and covering. But Moses does not present the command merely as a lesson in practical hygiene. Verse 14 expressly connects the camp’s holiness with the LORD’s presence. The sanitary requirement therefore belonged to a larger covenant responsibility. God did not require Israel to choose between practical cleanliness and reverence for His presence. He commanded both. A man who neglected the appointed procedure could not defend his conduct by arguing that the Almighty was interested only in spiritual matters. The LORD Himself had addressed the matter. The distinction between physical and spiritual responsibilities did not mean physical responsibilities could be disregarded when God had specifically commanded them.

There is also a sharp lesson concerning the difference between religious appearance and actual responsibility. Imagine a soldier delivering a magnificent speech about the holiness of Israel while refusing to follow the simplest instruction for keeping the camp clean. His speech might sound impressive, but the evidence surrounding his tent would offer a rather convincing rebuttal. A man who cannot be bothered to obey God in the ordinary duties of life should exercise caution before announcing that he has mastered the deeper mysteries of divine holiness. The practical principle extends naturally to responsible care of homes, workplaces, church facilities, and shared surroundings. Christians are not bound by Israel’s specific military sanitation procedure, but ordinary cleanliness, consideration for neighbors, and responsible treatment of shared spaces remain matters of practical wisdom. Spiritual seriousness is not demonstrated by neglecting the responsibilities everybody else must endure because one individual considers himself too important to perform them.

4. “The LORD Walketh” — His Presence Was the Reason the Camp Had to Be Holy

Verse 14 provides the controlling explanation: “For the LORD thy God walketh in the midst of thy camp, to deliver thee, and to give up thine enemies before thee.” The LORD identifies His presence as the reason Israel must maintain the appointed holiness. He was not presented as a distant observer with no concern for the people’s actual conduct. The covenant nation possessed promises involving divine assistance, and those promises belonged to a relationship governed by God’s commandments. Israel could not invite the LORD to accompany its army while treating His instructions as though they had been written by an incompetent quartermaster. The Almighty was not a decorative religious symbol carried along to improve military morale. He was the God of Israel, and the camp’s conduct had to reflect the seriousness of His presence among the people He had redeemed from Egypt.

Moses addressed Israel under the Mosaic covenant, when the LORD governed a literal nation through laws concerning warfare, ceremonial uncleanness, national holiness, civil responsibilities, and acceptable worship. These instructions were given to Israel’s military camp and covenant community, not to the Church as a collection of ceremonial regulations binding believers under grace. Christians today are not commanded to leave their neighborhoods until sunset because of the specific nighttime uncleanness described here, nor does a local congregation possess authority to reproduce Israel’s national laws. Salvation is by grace through faith in the finished work of Jesus Christ, not through ritual washing, sanitary regulations, or ceremonial separation. Nevertheless, the passage exposes enduring truths concerning responsibility, decency, sexual morality, honest offerings, and reverence for God’s presence. Rightly dividing the Scriptures does not make holiness unnecessary. It prevents men from confusing the commandments given to Israel with the instructions addressed to the Church. The ceremonies differ, but the believer must still take God’s word seriously.

1. The Host Going Forth — Military Preparation Did Not Suspend Holiness

Deuteronomy 23:9 begins, “When the host goeth forth against thine enemies, then keep thee from every wicked thing.” The setting is military. Israel’s host is going forth against its enemies, and the LORD commands the soldiers to maintain proper conduct. This is especially significant because warfare presents circumstances in which ordinary routines are disrupted, personal danger increases, and men may imagine that the urgency of their mission excuses behavior they would ordinarily condemn. But God does not establish a temporary exemption from righteousness whenever the army marches. A soldier does not become morally untouchable because he possesses a sword, wears the nation’s colors, or serves beneath an appointed commander. His responsibilities remain subject to the LORD. Military necessity does not become a substitute for divine authority, and victory cannot be used to justify whatever wickedness a man chooses to commit while pursuing it. The host belonged to Israel, but Israel belonged to God.

The command to keep from wickedness also belongs to the broader military legislation already established in Deuteronomy 20. Israel had received instructions concerning courage, exemptions from service, offers of peace to distant cities, judgments against the condemned Canaanite nations, and restrictions upon unnecessary destruction during sieges. Those distinctions demonstrated that warfare was not a condition in which every restraint disappeared. Now Moses adds the importance of holiness within the camp itself. A nation may possess an appointed military objective while individual soldiers remain perfectly capable of committing offenses God never authorized. The LORD’s presence did not turn every action of every Israelite soldier into righteousness.
